messages.subject: Help defining discretized normal distribution?
parts:
Hello Nimble users,

I'd like to define a discretized version of a normal distribution, and I'm not at all sure how to go about it. In principal it seems pretty simple: take the normal pdf at the integers and integrate to 1. Unfortunately, I can't seem to figure out how to even get started coding that as an R or Nimble function. Would this be fairly straight-forward to implement, or should I look for another approach to the problem it would solve?

Cheers,
Gregory

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Help defining discretized normal distribution?
parts:
Hi Gregory,

Here is one try, defining the discretized pdf as the area under the curve from x-0.5 to x+0.5.

ddiscnorm <- nimbleFunction(
 run = function(x = double(), mean = double(), sd = double(), log = integer(default = 0)) {
    ans <- pnorm(x + 0.5, mean = mean, sd = sd) - pnorm(x-0.5, mean = mean, sd = sd)
    if(log) return (log(ans))
    return(ans)
 returnType(double())
}
)

-Perry
